_: Masters Eight moveset vote - the candidate moves people vote on, 4 per Pokemon. Rebuilt 2026-10-26 from Pokemon Showdown / Smogon SINGLES data: usage moveset stats for 2026-09 (gen9 OU/UU/RU/NU/PU/ZU/Ubers, National Dex, ND UU, ND Ubers, ND Monotype, gen8 OU, gen7 OU - no doubles formats) topped up with Showdown's random-battle sets (gen 9/8/7) for Pokemon too rare to show in usage stats. Every move is checked against learnsets.json (the species and its prevos, any generation); OHKO moves are excluded. Per move: m=name, t=type, c=phys/spec/stat, u=highest usage %% seen in those formats (0 = from random battles or already animated), src=where it came from, cur=the set used in the videos today.
